notes.title: Controller Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222098/5ebab84bdcf33eafc60ded0d4235de6dc8505855.png"]

New update is here, including:

Better controller support 

Controller vibration support added

Weapon Wheel can be opened by pressing LB/L1 or TAB on the keyboard

Pressing Right Stick will the aiming center on the enemy closest to the center of the screen, kind like Souls games but the camera doesn't focus

Buttons can remapped and Controller vibration can be disabled in the menu

A few changes to the Cemetery Map that should make it more balanced and the puzzles a bit easier to understand

Removed placeholder stuff that I forgot to remove

HUD should now scale correctly at different resolutions

Health should slowly decrease once it's past 100 (this was already happening before but the HUD was being updated to show it)

Many bug fixes!

Saves on the Cemetery and Lab level of Episode 2 may be broken, sorry.

notes.title: Update on the game development
notes.notes:
Hi, sorry for the lack of updates, just thought I should say something. I'm still working on the game, fixing bugs, adding more enemies, maps, story bits and other things. 
I'm a solo dev though, trying my best here but sometimes life just gets in the way and it has been a pretty busy year for me.

Thanks for your support and patience.
Soon it will be fishin' time or something.

notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
It's been a while... finally added a better saving support so you can do it anywhere and not just at the start of levels. The cutscene that plays after the first level was now updated with new art by Bruno Atanazio. Other than that:
- Enemy AI overall reworked.
- The knife enemy can now jump (only on the last 2 difficulties though)
- Added a close melee attack to the Bazookrab
- All menus translated to pt-BR
- New sound effects added
- Lighting changed for the lava
- Added a visual effect when respawning
- Sound sliders properly working now
- Lots of smaller bugs

Thanks for your patience and thanks to everyone that sent me bugs and feedback. Working on new maps, enemies and such, next updates should be quicker.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.notes:
Some more small fixes:

New:
- Support for ultrawide resolutions added (I have no way of testing this so, again, if you have problems with it let me know)

Fixes:
- Tutorial was being displayed incorrectly in some cases
- NEW GAME was carrying player weapons from previous games some times
- Sniper rifle now displays correctly after a melee attacked is used
- Little Sponges now die when the boss dies
- Bullet holes are being saved and loaded properly
- Barrels are being saved and loaded properly

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone that reported bugs and sent me feedback, if you sent me something that wasn't fixed now, I'm still working on it, anyway, here's what on 0.1.2:

New:
- Support for 4K, 8K and all the resolutions in between (I don't have a monitor that supports something above 4k so you tell me if it works)
- Added a Bug Report option to send bug reports and feedback directly from the game!

Balancing:
- Oyster enemies damage lowered by 20%
- Bazoocrab damage lowered by 10%
- Added a few tips on Map 1 to help in parts people where getting stuck a lot
- Some changes made to Map 4 to prevent early access to later parts of the level
- Added more items in Maps 4, 5 and 6 to make things a bit easier.
- Ammo and scales don't get collected if player already has them maxed out (should be like this from the beginning, don't know what I was thinking)

Fixes:
- "Continue Game" option doesn't crash the game anymore if there's no save\
- Chests and vases are now being correctly respawned
- Elevators are now being correctly reloaded on respawned
- Respawning after a fall doesn't hurt the player anymore
- Shrimps and Little Sponges should respawn correctly
- Armored Kraken not freezing after player respawned
- Weapon sprites shouldn't be getting out of place now
- Fixed collision in several spots in Map 4 where the player could go out of bounds
- Fixed mouse sensitivity going too low if player died or enter a cutscene with the sniper rifle equipped
- Fixed an issue were Killer Blow would still shoot at player after dead!
- Game shouldn't crash as much on Map 4, those crashes are hard to figure out.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug in the first level where the player would get stuck and/or fall out of the map
- Fixed bug where enemies would sometimes float after getting pulled
- Boss music now stops playing after boss is defeated
- Other minor fixes that should prevent crashes
